entries.zh: 酵母；发酵用的引子（酵）
entries.en: leaven; yeast

entries.zh: 酒酵；酿酒用的酒曲/酵母（原文作「正糄」）
entries.en: leaven for wine; wine yeast
entries.notes: R 栏残作 "mara g vino"，推为 para (levadura) de vino；H 栏「糄」字旁注存疑。

entries.zh: 起酵；把面团发起（使发酵）
entries.en: to leaven; to set dough rising

entries.zh: 酒酵；酿葡萄酒用的酵母
entries.en: wine leaven; yeast for wine
entries.notes: R 栏仅 "q vino" 缩写，p̃ 即 para、Bino 即 vino，据以补足。

entries.zh: 白酒酵；酿白酒（米酒）用的酒曲（酒药）
entries.en: leaven for white rice wine; wine starter (chiu-ioh)
entries.notes: M 栏末音作 "iof." 且有 T99 污损，疑为「藥」；词义据 H 栏「白酒糄」定。

entries.zh: 饼药；做糕饼（薄饼）用的发粉/酵
entries.en: leavening for cakes/tortillas; baking leaven

entries.zh: 饼药起子；使糕饼发酵膨起
entries.en: cake leaven that makes pastry rise
entries.notes: H 栏「覘」疑为「起」，与 M 栏 "gûy"（起）合；R 栏 "a tamaiz" 残损，未详所指。

entries.zh: 面发；面团发起来（发酵膨起）
entries.en: the bread (dough) rises; to rise (of dough)

entries.zh: 起；起身，站起来
entries.en: to rise; to get up

entries.zh: 立；站起来，立起
entries.en: to stand up; to be on one's feet

entries.zh: 徛（站立）；站直、站起身
entries.en: to stand upright; to stand on one's feet
entries.notes: H 栏「堅」为「徛」之形误，M 栏 "guǐa" 正读徛（khiā）；旁注已标疑。

entries.zh: 起身；站起来（原字有疑）
entries.en: to rise; to get up
entries.notes: H 栏「壘」为借音字，旁注存疑；M 栏 "lǔi" 与第 9 条 "lûy" 疑同源。

entries.zh: 出类拔萃；在贵妇（众人）中超群出众
entries.en: to rise above others; to be eminent among ladies

entries.zh: 仰；抬起头向上看，仰望
entries.en: to raise the head and look up; to look upward

entries.zh: 踮起脚（张望）；企起脚
entries.en: to stand on tiptoe (to look)
entries.notes: M 栏首音 T99 污损、R 栏 "c forçar ne un chiñ" 残损，"ne" 疑为「踮/企」之音写。

entries.zh: 拾起；从地上捡起、扶起
entries.en: to pick up (from the ground); to raise up

entries.zh: 升；擢升官位、抬高身份
entries.en: to raise to a dignity or office; to promote
entries.notes: H 栏「陞」义明，M 栏 "Leng tàng cô chīn" 为例句音写，逐字未详。

entries.zh: 托起；往上抬、举起（托）
entries.en: to lift up; to hold up; to raise
entries.notes: L 栏 "subtuir" 费解（疑为 subir）；H 栏「託」与 M 栏 "ta" 之义据 R 栏例句 "levantarlo" 推定。

entries.zh: 接住并扶起（跌倒的人）；扶起跌倒者
entries.en: to raise up the fallen; to catch and help up
entries.notes: H 栏「接」与 M 栏 "soân" 对音不合，M 音未详，词义据 L 栏定。

entries.zh: 从下面推举起来；由下往上顶起
entries.en: to lift by pushing from beneath
entries.notes: H 栏「竅」旁注存疑（疑「竊」），M 栏 "guian" 无从比对，仅能依 L 栏立义。
